params.val: blocks an opposing move from being used against the holder at all if its effective priority is greater than 0
the opposing move's effective priority is not greater than 0
identical effect to Armor Tail and Dazzling

verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts (queenlymajesty): field-wide/foe-side-targeting moves (Spikes, Stealth Rock-style hazards, etc.) are normally exempt from being blocked at all since they don't target a Pokémon directly, EXCEPT for Perish Song, Floral Healing (flowershield), and Rototiller, which are explicitly still subject to the priority block despite their broad targeting.
